rows.en: ＊Riko＊＠１０６＿００１Quit spacing out! Do you even￥know why I came here today?
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿００２After getting a ranking like￥that, how can you be so￥laid-back?!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿００３Don't you ever think "I need to￥try harder" or "This is bad"?￥Not even once?
Of course I do!
Well, not really...
Of course I do!
Well, not really...
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿００４Hmph.￥Then why don't you act￥like it?
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿００５The only reason you got those￥results is that you're not￥giving it your all.
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿００６I knew it!＝＠１０６＿００７I've always thought so. You've￥got no sense of what it means to￥be a candidate.
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿００８Being so halfhearted only makes￥you and everyone else miserable!￥Why not just make up your mind?
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿００９If you really still want￥to go to Elan...
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１０then pull yourself together and￥give it a real shot!￥Though it might be too late now.
That's my plan.
Just leave me alone.
That's my plan.
Stop bothering me.
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１１Oh, so you've still got a￥little pride as a candidate!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１２Right now, if you give it￥everything you've got, you might￥still pull through!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１３If you've got time to sulk, put￥more effort into improving￥yourself!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１４At this rate, even if you go￥back to Sophia, nobody's going￥to take you seriously!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１５I'm not talking about your￥stats! I'm talking about your￥drive!!
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１６I've said everything I￥came to say.
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１７Put your hand on your heart and￥think hard about what I said.＝＠１０６＿０１８So you don't end up￥regretting it later.
＊Riko＊＠１０６＿０１９Well, sorry for barging in!
